AI Threads

BoobaStudio's AI Threads feature provides a persistent chat conversation with AI, embedded directly in your Foundry VTT journals. Use threads to brainstorm ideas, get rules clarifications, plan encounters, or role-play with an AI-powered NPC.

Overview

AI Threads are a special journal page type that maintains a conversation history with the AI. Unlike one-off prompts, threads remember context from previous messages, making them ideal for extended creative collaborations.

How It Works

  • Create a Thread — add a new journal page of type "Thread (GPT Chat)"
  • Choose a Model — select an AI chat model (GPT, Replicate models)
  • Start Chatting — type messages and the AI responds in context
  • Persistent History — the conversation is saved with the journal entry
  • Share — other players can view (but not edit) the thread

Creating a Thread

From a Journal Entry

  • Open or create a journal entry
  • Click the + button to add a new page
  • Select Thread (GPT Chat) as the page type
  • The thread interface appears with a chat input at the bottom

From the Welcome Screen

  • Open the BoobaStudio welcome screen
  • Click the AI Threads card
  • A journal with a thread page is automatically created

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Select the thread/chat option

Thread Features

Model Selection

Choose between different AI models in the thread settings:

  • GPT models — threads keep their history in the journal page
  • Replicate models — local history, good for open-source model access

Conversation Controls

  • Edit Messages — click on a previous message to edit it (local threads only)
  • Delete Messages — remove messages from the conversation
  • Max History — set how many messages the AI remembers for context
  • Max Messages — limit total messages stored in the thread

File Attachments

Upload files to provide context to the AI:

  • PDF documents — upload rules references or adventure modules
  • Images — share maps or character art for the AI to describe
  • Text files — provide background lore or session notes

Streaming

When available, responses stream in real-time so you can read the AI's answer as it's being generated.

Use Cases

  • Session Planning — brainstorm encounter ideas, plot hooks, NPC motivations
  • Rules Questions — ask about game mechanics with system-aware context
  • Roleplay Partner — have the AI play an NPC for practice or solo play
  • World Building — develop lore, history, and setting details collaboratively
  • Name Generation — get names for characters, places, and organizations in a conversational flow

Tips

  • Set the tone in your first message — "You are a tavern keeper in a medieval fantasy world" gives the AI a role
  • Be specific about your game system — the AI adapts its knowledge accordingly
  • Use threads per topic — create separate threads for different aspects of your campaign
  • The jump-to-bottom button appears when you scroll up — click it to return to the latest messages

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured provider (Module Settings → BoobaStudio)
  • Credit with your configured provider
